summary: MoneyHero Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, announcing changes to its Board of Directors. The Board appointed Steven Teichman as Chairman and Chair of the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee, replacing Kenneth Chan who resigned as Chairman but remains a Director. Additionally, Jacqueline Thong was appointed as a Director and Compensation Committee member. The Board accepted Derek Fong's resignation as Director, Committee member, and Chief Innovation Officer, effective May 19, 2026, stated as not due to any dispute. This is a governance reshuffle, not a forced departure, making it a routine board refresh. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Form 6-K. What to watch: continued board alignment with strategic vision.
